evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Descriptive, matter-of-fact framing of a reproduction task — low arousal, neutral-to-positive valence of confident identification.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative modal 'must' repeated twice carries urgency and constraint — high arousal, negative valence of alarm about failure modes.
